task_name: Price history panel pagination, retry, abort, and stale-response guard

concerns_addressed: api.ts:371 — fetchPriceHistoryReal now attaches status=404 on real Laravel 404 (commit 33635f9). Panel's classifyPriceHistoryError matches status===404, producing 'Produk ini sudah dihapus.' and calling onClose.
ProductRowDetail.tsx + page.tsx — onClose wired page→ProductRowDetail.onClose→PriceHistoryPanel.onClose (commit d92e2c1). 404 in integrated flow closes expanded row via closeExpandedRows().
Mechanical gate re-confirmed: 8/8 PriceHistoryPanel tests, 33/33 page tests, 66/66 total products suite, tsc --noEmit exit 0, git diff --check clean.

strengths: Complete AbortController + monotonically increasing requestId dual guard across initial load, load-more, product change, and unmount — no stale responses observed in tests.
Duplicate load-more protection via loadingMore flag + button disabled; retry key isolation on initial-load retries.
Dummy mode parity maintained: zero-network history, same pagination/empty/error presentation.
Clean separation: panel handles its own concurrency; page manages expansion lifecycle and filter/sort/page aborts.

issues.description: Adapter 404 status propagation (api.ts:373) lacks a dedicated test; panel 404 test uses fabricated Error({status:404, message:'Product not found'}) whose message also matches the regex fallback, so the test would pass even if status branch were removed. Consider an adapter-boundary test with a real 404 response body that does not match the regex.
onClose wiring (page.tsx:299 → ProductRowDetail.tsx:106 → PriceHistoryPanel.tsx:140) has no regression test. Removing the onClose prop at any layer would not fail the test suite.

Unstable callback identities: page.tsx passes historyFetch as inline arrow (recreated every render) and closeExpandedRows as plain function (recreated every render). PriceHistoryPanel's initial-load effect depends on [fetchHistory, onClose, retryKey], so any parent re-render (e.g., typing in search box while a row is expanded) aborts the in-flight history request and refetches. No test covers this interaction; useCallback for both props would stabilize.

Load-more request creates its own AbortController but never aborts it on unmount/product change; correctness is preserved by requestId guard, but the network request is not cancelled. Consider storing the load-more controller and aborting in cleanup.

api.ts uses (err as any).status = 404 instead of the existing ApiError class (src/lib/api-error.ts) which provides typed status and retryable semantics. Consistency with sibling admin pages (e.g., data-intelligence) would use ApiError.

Load-more 404 path classifies as deleted and shows 'Produk ini sudah dihapus.' but does not call onClose (only initial-load path does). DELIVERABLE "404 gives a clear deleted-product message and safe close" is satisfied for initial load; load-more deviation is a minor UX inconsistency.
